listing.name: Digimon World 2 — DW2-PC (Wyrelade)
listing.summary: Beta Digimon World 2 port prepared from your USA disc. Upstream’s broader gameplay claims have not been confirmed by Portcove; follow the extraction and build instructions below.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS01193 disc. Follow upstream’s per-file digest checks and build the data pack locally.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream setup to extract your own disc into a local data pack. Release ZIPs and source-build instructions are offered; keep the matching player and prepared data together.

warnings: This beta native port is based on 1,088 matching functions. Upstream’s broader gameplay claims have not been confirmed by Portcove.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
